title: Club setup

name.title: What's your club called?
name.hint: The crowd will spell it out. It also goes on your matchday graphics, and the short name goes on your badge.
name.label: Club name
name.note: Your badge until you add a crest. Colours come next.
name.noteDbu: Your crest from DBU. You can change it next.

crest.title: Add your crest
crest.hint: It goes on every graphic. A cut-out PNG sits straight on your colours; a crest on a white square gets a neat plate. Skip it to use a shield with your initials.
crest.plate: On a square, so it sits on a plate. Remove the background to lose the plate.
crest.sharp: Looking sharp. It sits on every graphic like this.
crest.none: Without a crest, your initials go on a shield in your colours.

kit.title: What do you play in?
kit.hint: Pick the nearest kit and watch the crowd change. Fine-tune the colours below.
kit.label: Kit

squad.title: Who's in the squad?
squad.hint: Paste it from the team chat, messages and all. Numbers, positions, (c) for the captain and a “Subs:” line are picked up; the chat is left out.
squad.label: Squad list
squad.placeholder:
1 Tom Hadley GK
4 Ryan Desai DEF
10 Callum Price MID
9 Harry Lund ATT
Subs: Talbot, Fenn

kitWarning: These two colours are very close, so names and numbers on your graphics will be hard to read. Pick a trim colour for the second one:

read.none: No players yet. You can add them later too.
read.found: {count, plural, one {# player found.} other {# players found.}}
read.benched: {count} listed as subs start on the bench; the rest fill their positions.
read.fill: They fill the spots for their positions; the rest start on the bench.
read.guessed: {count} with no position fill the gaps in list order.
read.chat: {count, plural, one {# chat line left out.} other {# chat lines left out.}}
read.warnings: {count, plural, one {# line needs a look} other {# lines need a look}}

warning.sameName: Same name as no. {other} in the list
